Name: Padmaster AI Assistant
Brief: Each game's controls drawn on the controller in your hands, plus an AI assistant inside LaunchBox.
Description: This is a beta. Pad Master draws each game's controls on a picture of the controller you actually use, read from the game's manual and from your emulator's own button settings, never guessed. Right-click a game for its picture; a game with no map yet asks to generate one. Add your own controller and your assistant finds its picture and places the buttons. The same plugin puts a chat panel inside LaunchBox: ask about your games, find a manual, or build playlists from your library. It uses your own AI subscription (Claude Code or Codex); the plugin stores no keys and its own server listens only on this PC, while your assistant sends what you type and what it reads to your AI provider.
Requirements: LaunchBox 14.1.x on Windows. Claude Code or Codex installed and signed in with your own subscription.
